تستعلمون (form X)
# تَسْتَعْلِمُونَ (tastaʕlimūna) /tas.taʕ.li.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
# تُسْتَعْلَمُونَ (tustaʕlamūna) /tus.taʕ.la.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْلَمَ (istaʕlama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
